race.comment: KING COBAMA (12) deep into the campaign now and gets a more economical run after sticking on to secure second over 1400m at Beaudesert. Scored a determined win over this trip at Gatton two back. Best figures should see him run well. SPICY WINGS (10) impressive winner first up from the outside gate when he swooped late to score a comfortable win over 1200m at Murwillumbah. Will continue to improve and this looks well within his grasp. SATIN AND CASH (13) starting to hit her straps with the two wins from the last four outings. Struggled to see the mile out with a plugging fourth at Coffs Harbour. Can make amends over her preferred trip. RUBOLOGY (5) looks to have the ability and is worth including.
